proposed_rows.role: spaces of continuous real functions with specified domain
proposed_rows.notes: Function names are additional input beyond scalar or pointwise value data.
Maximum absolute value on the compact unit interval.
Finite rational vertices and declared uniform error; not unnamed pointwise samples.
Error to the named function at most two to the minus n.

proposed_rows.role: 1995 strict pairwise polygon clause after syntax conversion
proposed_rows.notes: Source native delta_C has a different role from the host scalar delta_C.

proposed_rows.role: local and global compact-range box representations
proposed_rows.notes: Lists every true rational compact-to-open range property; zero padding carries no property.
Function modulus is computed from a uniform name; derivative modulus is explicitly additional input.
Scalar area and named function output remain distinct.

proposed_rows.role: derived slope or magnitude bounds and chosen mesh data
proposed_rows.notes: Finite rational or integer data obtained from names; not free global information.
One-sided endpoint derivatives extend continuously; ordinary function names do not encode derivative accuracy.

proposed_rows.role: sign-changing functions with no nondegenerate zero interval
proposed_rows.notes: Semantic promise; distinct from general sign change or uniqueness.

proposed_rows.role: source plateau and selector-counterexample polygon families
proposed_rows.notes: The two families have different middle vertices and different evidential roles.

proposed_rows.role: excluded compact complement and candidate isolating interval endpoints
proposed_rows.notes: Empty complement is vacuous; endpoints may lie outside the unit interval to handle boundary roots.

proposed_rows.role: name-realized zero relation on the promised class
proposed_rows.notes: Different names can legitimately produce different zero objects.

proposed_rows.role: effective open cover rational tents and weighted function
proposed_rows.notes: Nonnegative weighted series with explicit uniform tail; complement supplies zeros.
Small value does not itself bound distance to a zero or prove existence.

proposed_rows.role: native finite words and infinite source symbol streams

proposed_rows.notes: source=Weihrauch1995FunctionOperatorsFO; selectors=Definitions3.1/6.1/6.5 and AppendixC1; source-symbol streams are not Baire numerical-entry syntax.

proposed_rows.scope: P4 function operators native and host bridge
